shrunkEntries.removedBecause: Product Semantics Recovery WP1/WP2 (branch fix/product-semantics-recovery, 2026-09-29): measured ZERO violations across the whole 26x2xorder matrix. Root cause removed, not the check: recommendation/decision.ts and build-from-perspective.ts no longer zip humanOpenPositions onto round slots in ascending order and truncate to round capacity -- HumanActionability (recommendation/human-actionability.ts) carries eligiblePositions whole, separately from roundCapacity, and the V4 CurrentHumanDecision exposes every eligible position as actionablePositions (the Simulator selector renders exactly these). The oracle now also observes that V4 surface, and its precondition was corrected to HUMAN round capacity (the INV-OWN-004 formula: zero after an explicit yield) instead of side legality -- after a yield the open own-side slots belong to the Ally Bot, so offering them to the human would itself violate INV-OWN-004. Verified red: re-truncating eligiblePositions to roundCapacity makes this now-unlisted test fail.
shrunkEntries.previousReason: Position != Chronology (D2KIRO Phase 1.6 premise review correction): NOT merely that round capacity limits HOW MANY humanOpenPositions can be offered this round (that part is real, but round capacity alone would only ever explain a COUNT deficit, not which specific positions go unoffered). The actual defect is in apps/engine/src/recommendation/build.ts's own position-tagging for a controlledPositions session: it assigns humanOpenPositions to the round's open own-side slots via sort(humanOpenPositions)[i] -- a fixed ASCENDING order, capacity-truncated. Round capacity determines HOW MANY human-controlled positions may act this round; it should never determine WHICH ones are eligible, but the ascending-first tagging makes it do exactly that -- e.g. Party5 (5 human positions, round capacity 2/2/1) offers Pos1+Pos2 first, then Pos3+Pos4, then Pos5 last, every time, regardless of which positions the human would rather act on first. Not fixed in this task -- tracked for the separate Position != Chronology remediation audit.

shrunkEntries.removedBecause: Hypothesized (task section 16) as a direct consequence of INV-OWN-002, but NOT reproduced: measured exhaustively across every ascending/descending/deferred order-variant pair of all 26 control sets on both sides, comparing decision.controlledSlots offered positions at every matching (humanOpenPositions content, round) checkpoint -- zero violations found (2679 assertions run). Root cause of the null result: apps/engine/src/recommendation/build.ts's own position-tagging for a controlledPositions session assigns humanOpenPositions to round slots in a fixed ASCENDING, capacity-truncated order that is a PURE function of the current humanOpenPositions set + round capacity -- never of the history/order in which earlier positions were bound. INV-OWN-002 (capacity truncation: only min(roundCapacity, |humanOpenPositions|) positions are offered) is real and independently confirmed; which SPECIFIC positions get truncated is deterministic-by-content, not order-dependent, so INV-CHRONO-001 as literally defined (the OFFERED SET depends on fill order) does not hold for the channel this oracle observes. Per this registry's own semantics (a known failure that unexpectedly passes must shrink the registry, not stay stale), removed rather than force-fit a weak signal. Does not reopen INV-OWN-002, which remains a real, separately confirmed defect.
